questions.prompt: Prescriptive (planned) models bet more predictability is achievable; adaptive (agile) models bet that enough uncertainty exists that plans will need to be adjusted as the project progresses.
Waterfall will genuinely "outperform" Agile methodologies in contexts with low Changeability risk.
Agile is better at mitigating all types of Complexity.
XP bakes maintainability in as a first-class concern from day one (via continuous refactoring, test-driven development, sustainable pace) rather than treating it as a later bolt-on.
